subject: [PATCH 09/22] mm/ksm: restrict merging to common memory

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch restricts the merging of memory pages to only common memory, excluding ZONE_DEVICE folios and non-anonymous memory. The change is made in two locations where KSM (Kernel Samepage Merging) service acquires memory pages. This ensures that KSM does not attempt to merge memory outside the ordinary memory pool, which aligns with its opportunistic nature.
